title: What's new in v0.1.9
notes: Windows no longer flashes a white window at startup: the HWND stays hidden until the first GPU frame, then opacity, rounded corners, and the drop shadow are reapplied after winit rebuilds the window styles.
body:
### Fixed

- Windows no longer flashes a white window at startup: the HWND stays hidden until the first GPU frame, then opacity, rounded corners, and the drop shadow are reapplied after winit rebuilds the window styles.
